parts:
I want to estimate the proportion of households using ITN and the proportion of children who slept under ITNs

exp (-0.25) = 0.778800783
and for the second mean = 0.365 and exp (0.365) = 1.440514008.

How to determine the proportion of households using ITN and the proportion of children who slept under ITNs based on these results.
